_: Deliberate exceptions for scripts/check-parity.mjs. Empty lists are the normal state:
a line here means «we looked and decided this is right», not «nobody got to it yet».
unknown_identifiers — a term absent from openapi.yaml, openapi-partner.yaml and
llms.txt that is nonetheless legitimate in the documentation. Before adding one, check
the opposite first: more often it is a typo in a field name, or a genuine gap in the
shape_skip — a chapter whose Russian and English versions are deliberately built
differently. The reason had better be strong: a difference in shape almost always means
one of the locales does not know something.
